item.dc:creator: Julien Dubois
item.description:

item.ns4:encoded: AI coding tools can generate code quickly, but speed alone does not solve the hardest software engineering problems. Developers still need to provide context, validate results, protect maintainability, and remain accountable for what ships.

item.title: AI is changing developer work. Here are three skills to strengthen.
item.dc:creator: Gwen Davis
